name: DreamCo Financial Platform Contract
purpose: Personal and business financial software designed to reduce avoidable fees, automate financial workflows, compare lawful payment rails, and give Buddy one auditable financial operating layer.
product_positioning: Compete with modern global fintech platforms through lower total cost, automation, transparency, interoperability, and user control—not by bypassing banking or financial regulation.

cost_saving_engine.goal: Minimize total lawful cost to the user before a transaction is executed.

provider_abstraction.purpose: Avoid dependence on a single bank, processor, card issuer, or money-transfer provider.
provider_abstraction.rule: Providers are adapters, not the product. Provider availability and terms must be checked at transaction time.

global_transactions.target: Worldwide personal and business transaction support where legally and technically available.
global_transactions.routing_rule: Select the best eligible regulated rail based on total cost, speed, reliability, currency, limits, and compliance requirements.
global_transactions.important_limit: Do not claim universal country coverage; eligibility varies by jurisdiction, provider, product, sanctions, licensing, and regulation.

buddy_integration.material_external_action_rule: Buddy prepares and recommends financial actions; regulated or high-risk actions require the appropriate user confirmation, provider controls, and human review.

regulatory_architecture.principle: Build the software layer first and use licensed/regulated partners where required; pursue licenses and direct regulated infrastructure only when legally and economically appropriate.

middleman_reduction.goal: Remove unnecessary cost and manual steps without bypassing required regulated functions.
middleman_reduction.rule: Required banks, licensed money transmitters, card networks, regulators, attorneys, accountants, and other legally necessary professionals are not treated as unnecessary middlemen.
